title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment. We are looking for Fullstack Engineer, who wants to learn and transform his career. Mandatory Skills: Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.Js, and TypeScript Experience building modern web applications with reusable component-based architectures Experience with styling solutions in React, preferably styled-components Strong experience with Node.Js and Next.Js API routes for backend-for-frontend or API integration layers Experience integrating with external APIs and working with API gateway/proxy solutions such as Apigee or AWS API Gateway Experience with AWS cloud services, especially serverless solutions such as Lambda Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows, preferably with Jenkins Experience working with Git in collaborative development environments Experience with observability and monitoring tools, preferably New Relic Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Vitest, Mocha, or React Testing Library Experience working with Jira and Confluence Desirable Skills: Experience with Content Management Systems (e.G. Content Stack, Drupal, Payload CMS) Experience integrating or developing AI-enabled solutions Experience with Tailwind CSS Experience with Figma and collaboration with design teams using prototypes Experience with database services such as PostgreSQL and Databricks Experience with performance optimization, production support, and troubleshooting in cloud environments Responsabilities: We are looking for a Full Stack developer, self-driven, and self-learning professional to support critical automation initiatives within the Defense Center, with a strong focus on incident automation, workflow orchestration, and Jira backend enablement. This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and process thinking. The individual must be able to design and implement automation end-to-end, translating complex operational needs into scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve response efficiency. Given the nature of the work — highly integrated, security‑sensitive, and operationally critical — we need someone who can operate with high autonomy, quickly learn the environment, and continuously evolve the solution without heavy supervision or external dependency. <

title: Consultor De Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor De Vendas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa

Plataforma de carreira da nova economia com mais 10 mil alunos formados.

Somos uma empresa de educação que oferece cursos, pós graduação e mestrados

internacionais.

  • Missão: Gerar oportunidades de crescimento e mudança de vida para profissionais da área

que buscam sucesso e satisfação pessoal e financeira.


  • Visão: Ser a empresa referência no setor de educação para saúde e impactar mais

de 100.000 vidas e 5.000 profissionais


  • Valores: Clientes no centro, verdade, ambição e sentimento de melhorias.

Aqui no grupo Unilife acreditamos que o verdadeiro sucesso vem de uma equipe engajada e

inspirada. Nossa cultura reflete nosso compromisso em criar um ambiente de trabalho que

não apenas apoie o crescimento e o desenvolvimento profissional, mas também valorize

cada membro da equipe, acreditamos que cada colaborador tem papel essencial na

concretização da visão de impacto social da empresa. Aqui nossos colaboradores tem

possibilidade e visão de crescimento no nosso ecossistema.


Estamos contratando Consultor de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. As principais responsabilidades incluem atender clientes, buscar clientes, identificar suas necessidades e recomendar soluções educacionais alinhadas às suas metas. Você também será responsável por acompanhar negociações, esclarecer dúvidas e garantir um alto nível de satisfação do cliente. Este é um cargo presencial e em regime de contratação.


Qualificações


  • Consultoria de Vendas: Experiência em consultoria de vendas, conhecimento em estratégias de vendas e habilidade para identificar oportunidades no mercado.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente: Competência em manter a satisfação do cliente e oferecer um serviço de alta qualidade que corresponda ou supere as expectativas.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz para interações cliente e equipe, auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas e esclarecimento de informações.
  • Experiência em consultoria e atendimento ao cliente será um diferencial, assim como familiaridade com o setor educacional e ferramentas de CRM.


Informações Indispensáveis:

Modalidade PJ de trabalho

Modelo de trabalho híbrido: Segunda a sexta presencial e sábado home office.


O que é importante para o perfil:

  • Desejo de crescer na sua carreira
  • Desejo de sempre aprender novas habilidades

description:

desenvolvimento e implantação de agentes de IA em escala Coordenar e executar migrações de soluções de IA legadas para a nova plataforma Identificar de forma contínua bugs, gaps de documentação e barreiras de adoção, propondo soluções e acompanhando sua implementação Produzir materiais técnicos de alta qualidade, incluindo: Guias técnicos e tutoriais Arquiteturas de referência Runbooks operacionais Exemplos práticos de código Traduzir feedback das comunidades internas em insumos acionáveis para os times de produto e engenharia Atuar como autoridade técnica e principal ponto de contato entre a plataforma de IA e seus times consumidores Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões arquiteturais e de governança para soluções de IA Requisitos e qualificações: Experiência sólida com plataformas de AI/ML em produção em ambientes corporativos de grande porte Conhecimento profundo em agentes de IA, LLMs e padrões de orquestração de workflows Vivência prévia em enablement técnico, developer advocacy, arquitetura de soluções ou plataformas de IA Capacidade comprovada de produzir documentação técnica de referência e conduzir sessões de transferência de conhecimento Perfil altamente autônomo, com habilidade para identificar problemas, propor soluções e executar com pouca dependência de direcionamento Forte capacidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos diversos Desejável: Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP em contextos de plataformas de ML/AI Domínio prático de frameworks de agentes como: LangChain LangGraph CrewAI AutoGen ou similares Experiência com plataformas de MLOps (MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker, Kubeflow) Atuação prévia em grandes bancos, fintechs ou empresas de tecnologia com forte cultura de plataforma Vivência em ambientes de produto com title: Gerente Suínocultura
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente Suínocultura em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate).
  2. Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
  3. Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
  4. Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
  5. Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
  6. Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
  7. Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
  8. Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
  9. Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
  10. Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
  11. Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
  12. Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
  13. Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
  14. Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
  15. Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
  16. Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
  17. Garantir bem-estar animal.
  18. Atuar junto com fornecedores.
company: Grandy | Hunting Estratégico | Conectando empresas às pessoas certas

title: Líder De Equipe Externo- Mercado Pago - Feira De Santana-Ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder De Equipe Externo- Mercado Pago - Feira De Santana-Ba em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil.
  • Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima.
  • Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta.
  • Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação;
  • Experiência consistente em liderar equipes comerciais;
  • Estar disponível para trabalhar na região: Feira de Santana - BA


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

  13. Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
  14. Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
  15. Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
  16. Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
  17. Garantir bem-estar animal.
  18. Atuar junto com fornecedores.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. title: Ai Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Operations Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Our Client Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain. Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought\ "this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\ " this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-dataand remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;
comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;
You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;
their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;
outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-dataand remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;
comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;
You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;
their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;
outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Ai Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Operations Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Our Client Our client is an AI-led operating system for the drayage industry. They power trucking companies that move containers in and out of the ports, a mission-critical often overlooked corner of the supply chain. Drayage is a fragmented, relationship-heavy market with over 80% of carriers running fewer than 20 trucks, and they don't respond to mass-blast outbound. Winning here requires a GTM motion that's smarter, more researched, and more personalized than the rest of freight tech. That's where this role comes in. The Role We're hiring our first dedicated GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of sales, marketing, and product. You'll build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tooling that let a focused revenue team generate an enterprise-grade pipeline without enterprise-grade headcount. If you've ever looked at a sales motion and thought\ "this could be 10x more efficient with the right stack, the right data, and a few well-placed LLM calls\ " this is the role for you. You'll have the rare combination of a real ICP (drayage carriers and brokers), a rich domain (FMCSA data, port operations, chassis pools, intermodal flows), and autonomy to build. What You'll Own Outbound & Account Intelligence Build and maintain enrichment pipelines that combine FMCSA SAFER data, port activity signals, fleet composition, chassis ownership, terminal proximity, and TMS incumbency to score and prioritize drayage carriers and brokers Develop LLM-powered personalization workflows in Clay, Apollo, or similar so every outbound touch references the prospect's actual operating reality, not a generic\ "growing your trucking business\ " pitch Stand up intent-dataand remarketing reconciliation flows across our tech stack Sales Enablement & Pre-Call Intelligence Productize pre-call intel briefs into automated, repeatable artifacts AEs can pull on demand Build and maintain competitive battlecards and displacement playbooks for our most common takeouts (CompCare/Compcare, Profit Tools, Trinium, McLeod, Tailwind, in-house systems) Call Intelligence & Revenue Analytics Build pipelines from Gong (or successor) into LLM workflows that produce daily/weekly sales reports, surface objection patterns, flag at-risk deals, and feed competitive intel back to product and marketing Partner with RevOps to build attribution, conversion, and velocity dashboards that actually inform decisions not just decorate Monday meetings Field & Event Activation Build the systems behind PortFest, Drive, TPM and regional drayage association events: pre-event prospect lists, post-event nurture flows, on-site demo capture, attribution back to pipeline Help marketing run experiments on messaging, positioning, and channel mix and instrument them properly so we learn from what works Internal AI Tooling Stand up and govern internal AI workflows the GTM team uses daily: prompt libraries, custom Claude/GPT projects, RAG over our content library, MCP integrations with our CRM and call platforms Be the person who decides when a workflow should be a Clay table vs. a Python script vs. a real product request to engineering What We're Looking For Required 3+ years in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, Sales Engineering, or Growth Engineering role and a bonus if any of that was at a vertical B2B SaaS company Working proficiency in Python and SQL;
comfortable in JavaScript when needed Deep, opinionated fluency with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo (or similar), Gong, Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) prompt design, tool use, evals, cost management A track record of shipping systems that demonstrably moved a revenue metric: pipeline created, meetings booked, win rate, cycle time Strongly Preferred Domain knowledge in freight, logistics, supply chain, or trucking or proven ability to ramp on a complex vertical fast Familiarity with FMCSA data sources (SAFER, L&I, MCS-150), or analogous public/regulatory datasets in another vertical Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.), or production AI Orchestration You'll thrive here if you Get genuinely curious about the operational details of how a drayage carrier makes money: chassis splits, per diem, demurrage, accessorials, the difference between asset-based and brokerage authority Default to building rather than briefing;
You'd rather ship a v1in a week than write a 20-page requirements doc Treat AEs and CSMs as your customers;
their adoption of whatyou build is the measure of whether it worked- Are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows how a particular system actually works, and write things down so that changes What Success Looks Like By 90 days: Pre-call intel briefs and account enrichment are running on automation for the AE team;
outbound personalization quality is measurably higher By 6 months: Pipeline created per SDR/AE has meaningfully increased through better targeting and tooling By 12 months: PortPro's GTM stack is a competitive advantage and visiting peers from other freight tech companies leave wanting what we have

title: Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem somos: A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O que buscamos: Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras. Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado. Requerimentos & Skills: Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos. Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
Excelentes habilidadesde comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
Inglês avançado/fluente. Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)? #VEMSERSTUDIORX

title: Engenheiro De Ia Generativa - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Generativa - Especialista em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Descrição da vaga Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa, com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas. Responsabilidades e atribuições Suas atividades: - Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.
- Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.
- Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.
- Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.
- Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.
- Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.
- Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times. Perfil esperado: - Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
- Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.
- Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.
- Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.
- Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental. Requisitos e qualificações - Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.
- Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.
- Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.
- Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
- Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.
- Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos. Diferenciais: - Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.
- Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.
- Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.

You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Líder Técnico Salesforce
description:

Sobre a ília Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia. Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries! #Vempraília Sobre a vaga Estamos buscando um(a) Tech Lead Salesforce para liderar nosso time técnico de ponta a ponta! Buscamos um perfil híbrido: alguém que consiga organizar demandas estruturadas e, ao mesmo tempo, colocar a mão no código sempre que necessário. Responsabilidades: Atuar como líder técnico direto do time de desenvolvedores, apoiando no desenvolvimento profissional da equipe, realizando code reviews e garantindo as melhores práticas na plataforma. Fazer a ponte com a estrutura/gerência de projetos, ajudando a planejar, estimar esforço, priorizar e organizar o backlog de demandas técnicas. Arquitetar soluções escaláveis e seguras, garantindo a integridade do ambiente Salesforce. Desenvolver componentes complexos utilizando Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e automações avançadas. Desenhar e implementar integrações robustas (APIs REST/SOAP) entre o Salesforce e sistemas legados/externos. Sustentar e evoluir as nuvens core: Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Requisitos: Experiência prévia consolidada atuando como Tech Lead ou Liderança Técnica em projetos Salesforce. Domínio prático e avançado no desenvolvimento de soluções para Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Sólida experiência técnica na criação de Integrações de sistemas (APIs, webhooks, arquitetura orientada a eventos). Forte conhecimento em programação Apex, LWC, Triggers e ferramentas de automação (Flows). Habilidade em organização de processos e facilidade para trabalhar em sinergia com áreas de Gestão de Projetos (metodologias ágeis como Scrum/Kanban). Diferenciais: Certificações oficiais Salesforce. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e CI/CD aplicadas ao Salesforce (ex: Copado, GitHub Actions, Salesforce CLI). Benefícios e Incentivos: Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma presencial. title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Remote Work
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst - Remote Work em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work. Overview of the role: We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems. Key responsibilities: - Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.
- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.
- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders on the finished product.
- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau;
develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications - Conduct technical training.
- Maintain and document the operational environment.
- Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries. Requirements: - At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.
- An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.
- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.
- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.
- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.
- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).
- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).
- Advanced English level. Benefits: - Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement. If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto Principais Responsabilidades: Desenvolvimento de Framework Core: Desenvolver componentes modulares e reutilizáveis (Writer, Data Quality, Feature Functions) baseados em boas práticas de engenharia de software, evitando os famosos\ "Spaghetti Notebooks\";

Domínio avançado do ecossistema Databricks (incluindo Unity Catalog, Delta Tables, Databricks Workflows/Jobs);
Fortes conhecimentos em frameworks de validação de dados (ex: Great Expectations ou Delta Expectations);
Sólida experiência comMLflow para gerenciamento do ciclo de vida de modelos e linhagem de features.(;
Experiência prática com estratégias de versionamento de dados e histórico (SCD Tipo 2 / Tipo 4);
Proficiência em Pythonvoltado para desenvolvimento de pacotes, classes reutilizáveis e testes unitários independentes;
Conhecimento em conceitos de governança de dados (Metadados, Catálogo, Linhagem, Controle de Acesso). Diferenciais: Experiência prévia na implementação de Feature Stores do zero (ex: Feast, Databricks Feature Store);
Familiaridade com taxonomias de transformações complexas (MIT, MDT, ODT);
Conhecimento da metodologia/lógica de negócio modular E-A-C-TIM.

title: Especialista Técnico Sap I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Técnico Sap I em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações\ "Z\" tradicionais em favor deextensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna. Requisitos e qualificações Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban. #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Andela At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America. As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster. Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI. Join us and change the world. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / AI) to help build and scale the next generation of applications for one of our growing enterprise clients. This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert;
you approach your workthrough the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies Experience 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments. What We’re Looking For We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details Location : Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone : Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type : Contracting Duration : 12 Months Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026 Assessment Path : .NET Required Technologies : .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, Generative AI Apply Now Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert;
you approach your workthrough the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies Experience 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments. What We’re Looking For We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details Location : Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone : Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type : Contracting Duration : 12 Months Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026 Assessment Path : .NET Required Technologies : .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, Generative AI Apply Now Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.
